title: saZen73/aster-row-ai-agent
summary: saZen73/aster-row-ai-agent 是一个简单、可靠且保护隐私的AI辅助代理，用于Aster & Row任务。该系统采用检索增强生成（RAG）技术，实现精确的政策引用和确定性的工具调用，以安全地查询订单状态，同时不泄露内部数据或个人身份信息（PII）。，基于模型推理的架构
description: A simple, reliable, privacy-preserving AI support agent built for the Aster & Row assignment. The system utilizes Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for accurate policy citation and deterministic tool-calling to securely look up order statuses without exposing internal data or PII.
